svg.text: FitBud: Cloudflare staging and production (as configured)

Built from apps/api/wrangler.toml, apps/trainer-web/wrangler.toml and the deploy runbooks. Staging is drawn; production is identical with the names in the table below. Not AWS: see the note inside the boundary.
Cloudflare account: zone thefitbud.com (DNS, TLS, Workers custom domains)
Environment: staging (production uses the same layout)
Secrets come from Worker secrets, never from the repo
/api/* and /i/*; forwards both to the API.
No secrets, no database, no auth logic.
auth, relationships, plans, workouts, meals, sync, files...
rules, Firebase verify/exchange, Expo, email, WhatsApp
6 outbound HTTPS (fetch) with secrets from Worker env
push notification (Expo to APNs / FCM to the phone), routing data only
No VPC, subnets, availability zones, security groups, NAT gateway or load balancer exist in this repository.
Cloudflare manages placement and networking. The trust boundaries are the two public hostnames, the API Worker's auth gate,
and the bindings below. The Web Worker has no D1, R2, Queue or Durable Object binding; only the API Worker does.
Device-to-API traffic goes directly to the API hostname; browser traffic goes through the Web Worker (same origin, first-party cookie).
EAS builds go to TestFlight and Google Play closed testing by hand; they are not part of the Cloudflare account.
no direct D1, R2, Queue, DO
Auth: cookie fitbud_session (HttpOnly, Secure, Lax) or Bearer
Firebase ID token; role and ownership resolved on the server.
runtime-guard refuses test doubles outside local and staging.
Login: IP rate limit; lockout after 10 failures for 15 min.
Media URLs are HMAC-signed with expiry; R2 keys never authorize.
ZEPTOMAIL_TOKEN, EXPO_ACCESS_TOKEN, SENTRY_DSN, WA_*. Web API key is public.
D1 3M reads and 50k writes/day, 350 MB; R2 7 GB; 2,500 jobs/day;
250 sockets; p95 under 500 ms. Deploys are manual only.
